description: Source code for handling X.509 v3 certificate extensions related to CRL distribution points, including parsing, encoding, and printing functions within the OpenSSL project.

classes.name: DIST_POINT_NAME
classes.description: Represents the name of a distribution point, either full name or relative name.

classes.name: DIST_POINT
classes.description: Represents a distribution point with optional reasons and CRL issuer.

classes.name: ISSUING_DIST_POINT
classes.description: Represents an issuing distribution point with various optional flags and a distribution point.

methods.name: gnames_from_sectname
methods.description: Extracts general names from a section name or list.

methods.name: set_dist_point_name
methods.description: Decodes and sets a distribution point name from configuration.

methods.name: set_reasons
methods.description: Sets reason flags from a list of reason names.

methods.name: print_reasons
methods.description: Prints reason flags in human-readable form.

methods.name: crldp_from_section
methods.description: Creates a CRL distribution point from configuration section.

methods.name: v2i_crld
methods.description: Converts configuration values to a CRL distribution points structure.

methods.name: dpn_cb
methods.description: Callback for ASN1 handling of DIST_POINT_NAME.

methods.name: i2r_idp
methods.description: Prints an Issuing Distribution Point in human-readable form.

methods.name: v2i_idp
methods.description: Converts configuration values to an ISSUING_DIST_POINT structure.

methods.name: DIST_POINT_set_dpname
methods.description: Sets the distribution point name from an X509_NAME.
